name: Output-label sensitivity diagnostic (reports/48); frozen before any new inference

items.selection: src/mechinterp/label_diag.select_items: all 72 direct CONFLICT items (24 scenarios x 3 families) + per scenario (sorted base_id, index i) one TRUE=POS, one FALSE=NEG, one UNKNOWN=MISS direct control with families rotated TRUE->F[i%3], FALSE->F[(i+1)%3], UNKNOWN->F[(i+2)%3], F=(existential, universal, cumulative); 24 controls per status, 8 per (status, family). No dual-wording items. 2 of the 144 are earlier smoke-test items (reported; not excluded).

conditions.A: original system prompt (manifests/label_diag/system_prompt_A.txt == data/synthetic/exploratory_v1/system_prompt.txt); saved results from results/behaviour_full.jsonl reused after the replay check
conditions.B: ESCALATE -> NEEDS_REVIEW in both places it occurs; nothing else changed
conditions.C: neutral identifiers, rules listed in identifier order with explicit mapping lines: A=ESCALATE, B=ALLOW, C=DENY, D=REQUEST_EVIDENCE
conditions.D: neutral identifiers: A=DENY, B=REQUEST_EVIDENCE, C=ESCALATE, D=ALLOW
conditions.design_note: In A/B the order is ALLOW, DENY, REQUEST_EVIDENCE, ESCALATE/NEEDS_REVIEW (positions 1-4). In C and D every decision has a different identifier and list position from A and from each other. Two mappings cannot balance all 4 positions; ESCALATE occupies positions 4 (A, B), 1 (C) and 3 (D).

scoring.primary: total teacher-forced log-prob of '<candidate>\n' (same as the pilot); decision = argmax over the 4 operational decisions
sensitivity_normalisations: first-token log-prob only (removes length and termination effects)
mean log-prob per candidate token (total / n_tokens)
probabilities: p_choice = softmax over the 4 total log-probs (renormalised among candidates)
p_first = exp(first-token log-prob), the absolute next-token probability
scoring.tokenisation: manifests/label_diag/tokenisation.json (all first tokens distinct in every condition; token-ID concatenation equals text tokenisation)

workload.primary_new: 3 conditions (B, C, D) x 144 items x 4 candidates = 1,728 scoring forward passes (432 item evaluations; the approved maximum)
workload.dev_replay: condition A on 8 pre-declared items (manifests/label_diag/subsets.json) x 4 = 32 passes; purpose: verify bitwise compatibility of reused saved A results with the new code path
workload.dev_freegen: greedy generation (<=80 new tokens) on 12 pre-declared items (6 conflict: 2/family; 2 per control status) x 4 conditions = 48 generations; purpose: forced-choice vs free-generation agreement for the new interfaces and A on conflict items

metrics_per_condition: 4x4 confusion (gold operational decision x chosen decision)
conflict items: correct-escalation count and recall
controls: unnecessary-escalation count and rate (overall and per status)
mean p_choice(escalate) and mean p_first(escalate) on conflict vs controls
AUROC of p_choice(escalate) conflict vs controls (discrimination; separates a genuine conflict-specific shift from a global rise in escalation)
paired transitions vs A (per item: A decision -> X decision); conflict items: gained and lost escalations
all of the above under the two sensitivity normalisations (decision-level metrics)
uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over the 24 base scenarios (2,000 resamples, seed 0), percentile 95% intervals; items, labels and passes are never treated as independent scenarios
interpretation_rules: Report interface sensitivity if escalation recall changes; do not claim lexical preference is the only cause
A rise in escalation counts only as a decision-accuracy improvement if control unnecessary-escalation does not rise comparably (judged by accuracy on controls and the discrimination AUROC)
If conflict escalation stays low in all interfaces: discrepancy robust to these tested interfaces only
No causal or controllability claims; no steering
calibration: content-free label calibration NOT examined (no extra inference); stated as a limitation
no_tuning: wording, mappings, items and metrics fixed here; not changed after outcomes
